summary: Advanced Biomed Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of 100% of Acellent Technologies (Hong Kong) Co. Limited for 270,000 shares of common stock valued at $4.00 per share, totaling $1,080,000. The shares were issued in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. Concurrently, CEO Yi Lu mutually separated in connection with a strategic pivot to AI; Xiaomin Chen, sole shareholder of target, was appointed as CEO and Chairman. No premium, break fee, or advisor named. The transaction closed April 30, 2026. Watch for integration updates and shareholder reaction to the pivot.
